description: This file is a shell script used for managing GRE tunnels and hotspot configurations, including setting up network interfaces, retrieving parameters, and configuring iptables rules.

methods.name: init_snooper_sysevents
methods.description: Initializes snooper logs by enabling circuit and remote snooping features via system events.

methods.name: read_init_params
methods.description: Retrieves hotspot and GRE tunnel parameters from the PSM database.

methods.name: create_tunnel
methods.description: Creates GRE tunnel interfaces, configures bridging, and associates interfaces for tunneling.

methods.name: init_keepalive_sysevents
methods.description: Sets system events related to keepalive parameters for hotspot failover.

methods.name: update_bridge_config
methods.description: Configures iptables rules for forwarding and filtering network traffic related to the GRE tunnel.
